reclaimllm.note: Local ReclaimLLM MCP server for persistent AI-application memory and arbitrary memory search. Install and authenticate the rclm package first with `pip install rclm` and `rclm-hooks-install --with-mcp`; credentials are read from ~/.reclaimllm/config.json with RECLAIMLLM_SERVER_URL and RECLAIMLLM_API_KEY as fallback.
